Carl’s Thoughts On – Facing Hard Times
Hard times, we all face them at some point. The measure is in how we deal with it.
Life presses on us, it weathers us. Storms bend you this way and that, sometimes scarring us. But with God we can stand tall through it all.
Sometimes we’ll face challenges that seem impossible to handle. That’s when we go to God for help and take a step of faith. Even though you are tired and sore and you know it’s going to be tough you stand and face it.
(Philippians 4:13 I can do all this through him who gives me strength.)
Sometimes in life the weight doesn’t get lighter- we just get better at bearing it. Or we see God’s hand working in it.
Will there ever have a day when it doesn’t feel like a challenge?
Not this side of heaven, and I hope it will seem like a challenge. Because the days that are challenging are the ones that build and shape us.
There is something sacred in those rough times. Faith isn’t forged in the smooth easy times. It is shaped in the ruts and resistances of the trials we face. When we feel stuck, bogged down we need to turn to Christ back to our root, our source.
(Romans 5:3-4 Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.)
Others are watching, our children, friends and family see how we deal with hard issues. So even when we are worn thin our perseverance tells a story of our faith. Let our struggles, life’s issues plant seeds of faith long after you are gone.
(Proverbs 22:6 Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.)
Carl A. Gooch ~ 26 November 2025
